notes: «عن محمد، رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم» names the Prophet, who is the end of the chain and not a link (rule 12).

fixes.reason: RWY ends the route with «محمد», which is the Prophet's name written after Abu Hurayra's «عن»; the Prophet is not a link (rule 12).

evidence.quote: عن محمد، رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
